description: Issue #876: WalkingTec.Mvvm.Etl assembly controllers never received WTM's three global action filters' effect in time -- ASP.NET Core's own ControllerActionFilter (invoking a controller's own OnActionExecuting override) is hard-coded to Order = int.MinValue and always runs before any custom filter, so DataContextFilter/PrivilegeFilter/FrameworkFilter (which populate BaseController.Wtm) never got a turn before the five WalkingTec.Mvvm.Etl controllers' own role-gate overrides read Wtm -- it was always null there, so every caller including a genuine Admin was denied. The fix (WtmControllerActivator, src/WalkingTec.Mvvm.Mvc/Helper/WtmControllerActivator.cs) replaces the default IControllerActivator and populates Wtm at controller CONSTRUCTION time, before any filter runs. This mutant neutralizes exactly that assignment's guard (`baseController.Wtm == null` -> `false`), so Wtm is never pre-populated and the pre-#876 behaviour is reproduced: the three EtlControllerGateHttpTests admin-success tests added for #876 (a real ETLAdmin-role caller must pass the role gate and reach the action) go red because the caller is denied again, exactly like every other caller. Checked against all three -- EtlMonitorController_Running_Admin_Succeeds/EtlRunLogController_Index_Admin_Succeeds/EtlSchemaController_Tables_Admin_Succeeds -- each of which asserts a specific non-denial status (200/200/501) for the seeded ETLAdmin user; with the mutant applied all three instead observe the gate's 302 AccessDenied redirect. The green control is an unrelated, already-green negative-control test in the same test_project (EtlControllerGateHttpTests.EtlMonitorController_Running_NonAdmin_Forbidden), proving the mutation's build/test environment itself is not broken and that the mutant does not affect the (still-correct) non-admin denial path.

red_expected_assertion_patterns.WalkingTec.Mvvm.Api.Test.EtlControllerGa: #876: a genuine ETLAdmin caller must pass _EtlMonitorController's role gate and reach the action
#876: a genuine ETLAdmin caller must pass _EtlRunLogController's role gate
#876: a genuine ETLAdmin caller must pass _EtlSchemaController's role gate and reach the action body

red_expected_assertion_patterns_observed: Captured verbatim against the committed baseline (stale demo.db under bin/ removed first; mutant patch applied via git apply, test run, then reverted via git apply -R): EtlMonitorController_Running_Admin_Succeeds -- 'Assert.AreEqual failed. Expected:<OK>. Actual:<Found>. #876: a genuine ETLAdmin caller must pass _EtlMonitorController's role gate and reach the action -- this can only succeed if Wtm was populated with this user's real roles before the gate ran. Got 302 Found.'; EtlRunLogController_Index_Admin_Succeeds -- 'Assert.AreEqual failed. Expected:<OK>. Actual:<Found>. #876: a genuine ETLAdmin caller must pass _EtlRunLogController's role gate, reach the action, and have Wtm.CreateVM<EtlRunLogListVM>() succeed (it dereferences Wtm directly, so this also proves Wtm is populated, not just the gate's null-safe read). Got 302 Found.'; EtlSchemaController_Tables_Admin_Succeeds -- 'Assert.AreEqual failed. Expected:<NotImplemented>. Actual:<Found>. #876: a genuine ETLAdmin caller must pass _EtlSchemaController's role gate and reach the action body (Wtm.ConfigInfo.Connections lookup succeeds, then CreateSchemaService(SQLite) throws NotSupportedException, mapped to 501) -- not be rejected by the gate (302/403). Got 302 Found.' All three: gate denies with a 302 redirect (Found) instead of reaching the action, exactly reproducing pre-#876 behaviour. Manual dotnet test run of the full EtlControllerGateHttpTests class against the mutated tree: 3 failed (the three admin-success tests above), 3 passed (the pre-existing non-admin negative controls, unaffected).
